'''Task Force Pest''' was a [[Thaereian military]] unit that was created during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The task force was created by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rast'tul]] of the Thaereian military, on the orders of his superiors and in conjunction with [[Task Force Vermin]]. It was placed under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dalin]] and tasked with arresting [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Dalin would have them taken back to [[Thaereian Security Facility Number 12]], where anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] drugs were tested on them. After Dalin executed the force-sensitive vagrant [[Borus Ferthyn]] after a mob tried to prevent his arrest, it led to riots in [[Gadrin]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] were sent by the [[Cularin Militia]] to free some of the task force's prisoners soon afterwards.<ref name="Night's Promise" />
